frame: docs/design/rulings-2026-10-23d.md (the daze, the sell and the rally; behind rally.enabled)

links.name: Plate Chase
links.input: the chase with Y (LT with Y); with X it is the plain chase strike
links.what: the zip drives him into the body forearm-plate first, and the body is sent exactly along the stick's line, snapped to one of eight directions, with no bend from the planner. With the stick neutral, the line is straight on along the chase. An empty line is his choice, and the choreographer scores it low for variety, which is his trade (23d item 19)
links.tech: item 8 with 23d item 17's middle step: 4 ticks for a fresh kind, 6 for a kind used earlier in the rally but not as the last link, 8 for the same kind as the last, and a third of one kind is teched by itself
links.tell: the forearm comes up square, the plates lit in a line
links.look: a straight ram, no wind-up flourish; a clean line of violet behind the body
links._renamed: Narrative: Plated Ram became Plate Chase, so it doesn't echo Rank Breaker
links._ruled: 23d item 19: allowed. The tier's collateral budget still caps the deaths on that line (no borrowing at tiers 1 and 2: a place over budget evacuates), and a surface on the line is met by the ricochet rules

links.name: Ring Hold
links.input: RB with A at the body in flight
links.what: Rank Ring snaps round the body's arms and torso and his payoff, the bind, holds it where it is in the air; his next shot lands as on an open fighter, inside the catch or within 6 ticks of its end (20 item 3), and that shot sends it on
links.destination: in place, then the shot's line
links.tech: item 8 with 23d item 17's middle step: 4 ticks for a fresh kind, 6 for a kind used earlier in the rally but not as the last link, 8 for the same kind as the last, and a third of one kind is teched by itself
links.tell: a short closing pull of his fist
links.look: the body stops dead in the air, struggling inside the loop; a needle or a heavy blast follows
links.legal: Legal RL-183: named Ring Hold, never Hang. A thin loop that closes, never a disc or above the head (e12); it binds arms and torso and the held fighter struggles, never dangling; no zoom, slow motion, taunt or finisher over him; the shot on him is a normal hit; one call-out (ln06)

links.name: Stair Spike
links.what: one press, one attack: he drives the body down in three short steps of 1 bh, plate, plate, plate, and the third is the crater. On hard ground under the plant speed it glances back up as every spike does; on soft ground the rally ends
links.tech: item 8 with 23d item 17's middle step: 4 ticks for a fresh kind, 6 for a kind used earlier in the rally but not as the last link, 8 for the same kind as the last, and a third of one kind is teched by itself
links.tell: he rises over the body with the fist cocked at the shoulder
links.look: three stepped impacts in a straight vertical line, merged into one glow that brightens only at the last (Legal mc04: one burst event, to be proven in a clip)

sell._frame: 23d item 4: in the daze each landed medium or heavy takes the launch's hit-stop (12), a camera push and a reaction a size larger; the sell is the look, never the number

medium.head: snaps with the blow and is snapped straight at once, jaw set
medium.body: barely folds; his feet skid back further than anyone's
medium.recover: straightens a plate on his forearm while he is pulled in

heavy.head: turned hard, his glare back on the attacker before his body follows
heavy.body: a short fold, a long skid back

send.look: launched rigid and straight, arms in to his sides, refusing to flail until the flight turns him

sell.voice: a hiss through the teeth, never a cry
sell._legal: the body is never limp; no slow motion beyond the hit-stop, no taunt over a dazed fighter; each sold blow is one flash event at most (fx08)

legalAsks: the ring hold in the air
the three-step spike as one burst
_flash: Legal mc04: the flash cap of 3 counted bursts a second holds across the whole rally; a link whose flash would pass it draws as dust, trail and ember instead
_ownKind: ruled (23d item 17): each own link is its own kind for item 8's grip and item 13's scoring
